description: Sidewalks is a dataset listed in Cary, NC Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Town of Cary. Feature layer that shows sidewalks. This dataset pairs well with the Curb Ramps dataset. Coverage: Cary, North Carolina. The portal files it under Geographic Information System (GIS). The portal shows 6,855 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-townofcary-org-portal.
